messages.content: 你能提供關於電影《全面啟動》的簡介，然後再幫我檢索有關同一部電影《全面啟動》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息，以及電影《黑暗騎士》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息嗎？

function.description: This function retrieves a brief about a specified movie. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

The function signature only accepts title and optional extra_info. It can only retrieve brief or extra info for one movie at a time. We need to call the function twice: once for Inception with extra_info true, once for The Dark Knight with extra_info true. The user wants both. So we should call the function twice. The user didn't specify whether they want the brief first or the extra info. They said "簡介" then "再幫我檢索有關同一部電影《全面啟動》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息，以及電影《黑暗騎士》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息". So we need to provide the brief for Inception, then extra info for Inception, then extra info for The Dark Knight. We can do it in two calls: first call for Inception with extra_info true. That will give us brief and extra info. Then second call for The Dark Knight with extra_info true. That will give us brief and extra info. The user didn't ask for brief for The Dark Knight, but we can provide it anyway. The function returns brief and extra info. So we can call it twice.
